01With the winter months approaching, our customers try at all costs to get their building work done while the weather is still…

With the winter months approaching, our customers try at all costs to get their building work done while the weather is still fine. Sometimes the conditions are already borderline, especially when it comes to carrying out earthworks.

We recently installed and commissioned a domestic wastewater treatment plant in the village of Vydří near Jindřichův Hradec. The owners had bought an older family house and set about refurbishing it completely, which included doing away with the existing holding tank, which had to be emptied by tanker, and replacing it with a WWTP. They chose the bestseller from ENVI-PUR, s.r.o. – the BC 4 OPTIMA model in the standard height of 2,050 mm.

02This time it was no picnic, because the WWTP tank was being placed inside the former holding tank…

This time it was no picnic, because the WWTP tank was being placed inside the former holding tank. On top of that, there was barely any room to spare, and not much space for handling the pipework either. The client will redo the internal drainage in due course; for now it is connected temporarily to the existing pipework.

Domestic wastewater treatment plants can be installed in existing holding tanks, but you need to check that the standard size will fit inside the tank. If you would like to go into the subject in more depth, don't hesitate to get in touch for a no-obligation consultation.
